connector.name: Leadhound API
connector.registryDescription: Sales prospecting and lead generation from Google reviews: local businesses leaking leads, scored.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.leadhoundapi.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.leadhoundapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Set to 'Bearer lh_live_...' with an API key from leadhoundapi.com. Leave unset to sign in with OAuth instead.
